# Power steering pump noise diagnosis

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] A loud RAWRing or whining sound indicates air in the fluid caused by a worn pump. [t2289]

## Parts

- [Partial] Pump: Rotors crush air bubbles causing noise. [t2289]

## Tips & gotchas

- [Partial] A loud RAWRing or whining sound indicates air in the fluid. [t2289]
- [Partial] Caused by a worn pump, well-worn fluid, or improperly tensioned belt admitting air. [t2289]
